MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Medicare Mental Health Service Armadale

We are seeking an enthusiastic and compassionate Administration Officer to join our Medicare Mental Health Service in Armadale on a permanent part-time basis.

As an Administration Officer, you will play an important role in supporting the delivery of a welcoming, accessible, and client-focused service. You will provide high-quality administrative and clerical support to the team, while creating a positive first point of contact for clients, their families, and carers accessing our service. You will also support caregivers with a range of administrative tasks that enable the effective delivery of mental health services.

The Armadale Medicare Mental Health Centre provides free, easily accessible support for people aged 18 years and over. We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment where individuals can access mental health information, services, and support from qualified professionals, without the need for an appointment or referral.

Our service is delivered by dedicated mental health professionals, with clients supported from the moment they arrive by trained peer workers who provide guidance and connection throughout their experience. This is an opportunity to contribute to a service that helps people access the right support at the right time.

The Position

Provide administrative support to the Service Manager and team.

Establish and manage effective and efficient office management systems.

Prioritise and coordinate work to meet designated time frames.

Manage the electronic client management system (CMS) for client records and administrative information.

Assist caregivers with the collection of data for quality indicators, finance reports and service specific statistics.

Support data extraction and analytics for benchmarking.

Provide secretarial support to service meetings.

Ensure typing and distribution of minutes, correspondence and memos are completed in an accurate and timely manner.

Arrange venues, equipment and catering for all service events.

Manage an effective filing system for client records and administrative information, including manual and electronic systems.

Assist in the design and desktop production of presentations, fliers, reports and publications.

You will hold strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and engage effectively with a diverse client base, caregivers, and stakeholders. Whilst providing a welcoming and supportive experience for individuals accessing the service, you will have the ability to respond with professionalism and empathy to their needs.

The successful applicant will have solid experience in reception and office administration, with an understanding of systems and processes used to manage client information, appointments, and data collection. You will demonstrate a high level of customer service, with strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent attention to detail and accurate data entry capabilities.

In addition, you will possess sound planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks, manage competing demands, and work effectively in a busy service environment. 

A current WA driver's licence and National Police Clearance are essential for this role.

Above all, patient care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $74,627 to $78,011 (pro-rata for part-time) plus 12% Superannuation

Permanent part-time, working 20 hours per week

Monday to Friday | 8.30 to 12.30pm

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave & well-being programs

Access to gym membership, fitness and wellbeing benefits through Fitness Passport for you and your family.

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Innovative Professional Development opportunities

All applicants are asked to submit a current CV and covering letter (of no more than two (2) pages) demonstrating how you meet the above position requirements.

For enquiries contact Liam Dekker, Manager Medicare Mental Health Service on 0437 020 195.

Applications will be reviewed throughout the advertising period and interviews conducted regularly. If suitable applicants are identified advertisement may close prior to listed date. Apply today!

Lead enterprise-wide AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives for a growing Adelaide organisation   
  Your New Company  
 Our client is a highly successful Australian organisation with a national footprint and a strong growth trajectory. Operating in a complex, fast-paced environment, the business is investing heavily in digital capability, automation, AI, and enterprise technology to drive operational excellence and commercial performance. 
 This newly created executive leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of the organisation by identifying, delivering, and embedding transformative technology initiatives that create measurable business outcomes. 
   
  Your New Role  
  Reporting to the executive leadership team, you will lead the organisation's digital transformation agenda, with a strong focus on delivering tangible commercial outcomes through AI, automation, systems integration, data, and technology-enabled change. 
   
 This is far more than a traditional IT leadership role. You will act as a strategic business transformation leader, identifying emerging technologies and translating them into practical opportunities that improve profitability, productivity, customer engagement, and operational performance. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 
 Driving the organisation's digital transformation strategy and roadmap. 
 
 
 Delivering AI and automation initiatives with measurable ROI and business impact. 
 
 
 Leading large-scale enterprise programs across ERP, CRM, data, integration, reporting, and customer platforms. 
 
 
 Developing and presenting business cases to executive and board-level stakeholders. 
 
 
 Leading organisational change and ensuring successful adoption of new technologies and ways of working. 
 
 
 Providing strategic oversight of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure resilience, and technology governance. 
 
 
 Partnering with senior executives to identify new opportunities for innovation, efficiency, and growth. 
 
 
 Managing technology vendors, delivery partners, and internal technology teams. 
 
 
 Supporting acquisition and integration activities through scalable technology and data strategies. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 To be successful in this role, you will bring a combination of commercial leadership, digital transformation expertise, and strong technical fluency.   
 You will demonstrate: 
 
 
 Proven experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. 
 
 
 A track record of delivering AI and automation solutions into production with measurable commercial outcomes. 
 
 
 Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience developing and defending business cases with executive stakeholders. 
 
 
 Experience driving behavioural change and technology adoption across large and complex organisations. 
 
 
 Technical credibility across cloud platforms, systems integration, data architecture, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications. 
 
 
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at both executive and operational levels. 
 
 
 Experience leading cross-functional technology, project, and business teams. 
 
 
 A genuine passion for emerging technologies and a demonstrated ability to stay at the forefront of industry trends. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Get in Return  
   
 In return, you will secure a rare opportunity to lead transformation at an enterprise scale and directly influence the future direction of a growing organisation. 
   
 You will enjoy: 
 
 A highly visible executive leadership position. 
 The opportunity to shape and execute a genuine digital transformation strategy. 
 Significant investment in technology, AI, automation, and innovation initiatives. 
 Direct exposure to executive and board-level decision-making. 
 The ability to deliver meaningful commercial outcomes and leave a lasting impact on the organisation. 
 A competitive executive remuneration package.

Join a highly respected Australian defence technology organisation delivering complex engineering programs that support critical national capabilities. With a strong focus on innovation and project excellence, this organisation offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of sophisticated, software-intensive systems within a highly collaborative environment.  
  Role Description     
  As the Configuration Management Officer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and maintaining CM activities across the full project lifecycle. Acting as the primary point of contact for CM-related matters, you will ensure configuration control processes are effectively implemented and maintained while supporting engineering, project, and IT teams.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Execute and maintain CM activities across all project stages, recording and maintaining product hierarchies and identifiers within baseline documentation.  
  Act as Secretary to the Configuration Control Board (CCB), circulating paperwork, scheduling meetings, and ensuring change processes are successfully completed.

  Security Clearance: Must hold an active NV1 Australian Defence security clearance or have the ability to obtain one.

  Education: A Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, IT, or a related field is highly regarded, alongside prior Defence Industry experience.
